extraction.notes: This figure shows four line plots comparing different approximation methods (one-sided GS left-to-right, one-sided GS right-to-left, two-sided GS, and ZB-splinets) for Δλ₁ (green) and Δλ₂ (black). However, there are no explicit numerical values, data point annotations, or cell values visible as text labels in the figure. The figure only displays visual curves on axes with numerical scales (0-90 on x-axis, -0.1 to 0.4 on y-axis), but these are axis labels, not data values to be transcribed. Without explicit text annotations or data labels on the curves themselves, there are no numerical values to extract for the table cells.
